quantitative_conclusions: L577-L500 final improves AbsRel,RMSE,delta1 and F1 with CIs excluding zero and both seeds agreeing;band CI crosses zero. Final F1 increment+0.0060798786 CI[0.0031373585,0.0093250011],opposite the averaged best-model boundary increment.

L577-R577 best improves AbsRel -0.0065110565 CI[-0.0128458574,-0.0008341267],RMSE and band;delta1/F1 CIs cross zero. Final improves AbsRel,RMSE,F1 and band;delta1 crosses zero. Final F1 +0.0092218573 CI[0.0011382598,0.0175421286]. Only the same two seeds are compared.

L577-B0 best and final improve AbsRel,RMSE,delta1 and band with CIs excluding zero. F1 still crosses zero at both endpoints: best+0.0012411356 CI[-0.0077156022,0.0112803274],final+0.0088015163 CI[-0.0003614684,0.0186190539]. Do not claim a demonstrated general boundary gain over B0.

Final-best two-seed F1 improves+0.0075603808 CI[0.0053489567,0.0103401733],both seeds agree. Other four CIs cross zero. Both best-selected AbsRel values are lower than final,but there is no across-scene certainty for this small average drift.

Scene bootstrap2000 image-weighted resamples of62 scene clusters,seed320119,is conditional on these two training seeds. Seed SD is separate,no multiplicity correction. Third seed remains pending;do not use the two-seed577 versus three-seed500 plot as the paired estimate.
training_review: Best2000 is the final significant-improvement anchor;fixed ten-check patience stops3000.3000 attempts2998 successful updates24000 exposures41.59445 effective epochs. Two AMP skips at68/517,none later. One closed attempt,no runtime failure/restart.

Final AbsRel1.0120% above best,just over the frozen1% threshold0.0879089703;final0.0879194148 therefore fails it. Most2300-2800 checks also fail. stable_step null,stable count0/2. Threshold is not relaxed after observing this near-boundary case.
Target0.10 begins100,confirms300 at140.623263s. Target0.09 begins200,confirms400 at184.159923s. Both completed seeds reach both targets,but neither meets the terminal stability criterion.

Training loss declines while validation flattens after the2000 best and ends slightly worse;late-loss-down/val-up indicator true. Ten post-best points retained,max0.0888566908. This is mild late degradation compatible with overfitting,not explosive numerical collapse;two early AMP skips do not establish its cause.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0005: Both lower B0 overall depth error while missing the whiteboard perimeter. Final depth slightly improves0.06293->0.06231 but F1 falls0.3423->0.3376;table/chair junction contour shifts are small,with some extra unmatched fragments. No structural recovery.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0598: Final reduces broad sofa/floor depth error0.05399->0.04823,approximately B0,while F1 improves0.4903->0.5053 but remains below B0. Small matched sofa/table-edge fragments increase;right tabletop remains interrupted and thin legs remain missed.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_1440: Final slightly worsens depth0.11510->0.11794,both worse than B0. Chair-post cyan contours look almost unchanged,F1 0.53986->0.53946;counter boundaries are still largely missed. Boundary F1 above B0 does not repair broad metric errors.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0226: Both strongly improve B0 scale error;final slightly worsens AbsRel0.13502->0.13901 and F1 0.49425->0.49151. Person,column and sofa contours stay coherent,butbranch mismatches and missing furniture persist. Changes are small and do not justify a recovery claim.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Final slightly improves depth0.15575->0.15141 and F1 0.48006->0.48220,but both measures remain below B0 quality. Main foreground contour looks similar;small false shelf segments change. False ceiling edge and missed shelf sides persist.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Positive endpoint boundary counterexample:final extends some matching upper/lower shelf-post segments,695->766 predicted edges,F1 0.5784->0.6058. Both are substantially better than B0 on this boundary. Depth AbsRel nonetheless worsens0.06431->0.06725;geometric and depth-value outcomes differ.

interpretation: Two-seed L577 shows lower RMSE and boundary-band error than matched L500,but best AbsRel increment remains uncertain and best boundary F1 declines on average. Final weights show a different boundary tradeoff. Mild late degradation is preserved;the new third seed,not tuning,will determine the full-group summary.
